What makes this a candidate?

Distinct identities and legitimate reads were checked before the cross-user observation. The reviewer still needs to confirm intended access and impact.

What stays out of the finding list?

An allowed share, an expired session or missing evidence must not turn into a vulnerability just because a request returned an unexpected status.
